order: Close the outstanding MAJOR finding in the verifier's throwaway-checkout path. A failed pre-add snapshot of git's worktree records, combined with an aliased add whose alias later vanishes, can strand a canonical registration nobody can name afterwards. Make the pre-add records read a hard prerequisite, so git's spelling must be legible before anything at all is registered, and retry a transient post-add read failure rather than treating the first stumble as final. Show that the residual cleanup path heals itself, so an alias-created registration that never reached the active set is reclaimed by the standing sweep on the next checkout. Pin that self-healing with a regression test rather than asserting it in prose, and let the test prove the directory and the registration are both gone. Record the round's review verdict verbatim, hold the tranche at REVISE pending the next pass, and leave the suite battery green.
claims: Done. The pre-add records read now refuses before any registration exists. A post-add read failure is retried before the ambiguous-records path is taken. The residual strand is proven self-healing by a new regression test that stands up an alias-created, never-active registration and asserts the directory and the registration are both reclaimed by the following checkout. The round's verdict is recorded verbatim and the tranche disposition is carried forward. The full battery is green, with verifier at 101, router at 135, registry at 31, and the review lane at 116.
